mapper.sql: id, row_version, project_id, generation_job_id, operation_type, estimate_min, estimate_max, max_authorized_cost, confidence
mapper.select: INSERT INTO operation_plans (project_id, generation_job_id, operation_type, estimate_min, estimate_max, max_authorized_cost, confidence) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{generationJobId}, #{operationType}, #{estimateMin}, #{estimateMax}, #{maxAuthorizedCost}, #{confidence}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_plans SET project_id = #{projectId}, generation_job_id = #{generationJobId}, operation_type = #{operationType}, estimate_min = #{estimateMin}, estimate_max = #{estimateMax}, max_authorized_cost = #{maxAuthorizedCost}, confidence = #{confidence}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
